title: Research session planning
summary: [00:00-00:43] Research focus — Participant A proposes sessions to see how people interpret a label and navigate the current prototype; Participant B agrees to observe one version rather than compare alternative labels in the same session • [00:43-01:16] Session setup — Participant A confirms thirty-minute sessions using fictional task data without requiring account creation • [01:16-01:52] Facilitation — Participant C asks about question wording; Participant A discusses neutral questions and providing task instructions both verbally and in writing • [01:52-02:41] Prototype preparation — Participant B will replace an editable address field with a sample location and check navigation and keyboard operation; the prototype work is expected Wednesday afternoon • [02:41-03:06] Facilitator guide — Participant A will write the facilitator guide, which is expected Thursday morning • [03:06-03:48] Recruitment & scheduling — Participant C says recruitment arrangements and incentives still need checking; six sessions have been suggested, but participant numbers and session dates are not yet settled
